Design Philosophy

More than landscaping. A better way to experience outdoors.

"We view the land not as a blank canvas to be decorated, but as living architecture that should deepen in character with every passing season."

Evergreen Landscapes bridges the natural ecology of the Pacific Northwest with timeless architectural principles. Whether orchestrating a comprehensive residential master plan, laying natural thermal bluestone, or introducing specimen hornbeams, we create spaces that invite daily living into the open air.

Craft Standards

Thoughtful design. Quality work. Lasting beauty.

We build landscapes with the rigor of architectural construction and the sensitivity of master horticulturalists.

01

Personalized Design & Site Harmony

No two sites share identical soil, slope, or microclimate. We tailor every blueprint to the exact contours of your land, ensuring seamless indoor-outdoor sightlines and natural privacy.

  • Topographical elevation & drainage studies
  • Customized sunlight & shadow mapping
  • Architectural style integration with your residence
02

Enduring Materials & Quality Plants

We reject fragile shortcuts. We build using hand-selected quarry bluestone, dry-stacked basalt, sustainably harvested cedar, and acclimatized nursery flora chosen to flourish decades ahead.

  • Direct quarry sourcing for natural stonework
  • Premium disease-resistant sod & perennial cultivars
  • Structural subterranean drainage & weed defense
03

Single-Point Accountability & Technology

From design to construction, you collaborate with one dedicated team. Our integration with MyFormConnect guarantees seamless proposal requests, live scheduling, and rapid enquiry response.

  • Transparent line-item material proposals
  • Direct online booking for 30-minute site walk-throughs
  • Dedicated on-site construction superintendents
